description: BLOCKED on the bitstring/binary type split (proposal page pending). Builder work is held uncommitted in ../fz-nml13 (branch fz-nml.13 on fz-nml.11): is_bitstring as a Kernel type test, fixture 01360 (block 01360-01379 claimed for fz-nml), and 01338's <<1::3>> wording cases. Finding: fz has one binary type that holds bitstrings of any bit length, so is_binary(<<1::3>>) is true and byte_size(<<1::3>>) type-checks then panics. A runtime is_binary breaks guard narrowing (64 fixtures red), so the holistic fix is in the data model: bitstring is the broad type and binary (whole bytes) its subtype, as in Elixir. Rebuild .13 on that split; no fz_bitstring_is_binary in :binary guards. The distiller pin rose (18334,111796) -> (18335,111802) with the held work; not authorized.
title: is_bitstring/1 is a guard, and :binary raises Elixir's 'is a bitstring' wording
